limitations: Forty owned synthetic clips contain twenty scenarios and twenty labeled variants using two US-English voices. One separately licensed human British-English excerpt broadens accent coverage; it is not representative of all accents.
The owner qualitatively accepted the original 23 completed examples. Numeric supported-point and timestamp metrics remain unannotated; the additional 18 examples are not marked human accepted.

All forty original clips eventually succeeded. Three failed initial attempts were preserved and received one explicit bounded retry under the corrected provider-settlement code. Unknown historical holds were not released.
Two repositories are owned local excerpt fixtures, not installed customer repositories. Matching used actual metered inference and strict references; this dataset did not publish GitHub tasks.
Receipts show conservative EUR inference estimates and service credits, not paid provider invoices or all-in infrastructure costs. Settled USD invoice cost remains unknown.
The dataset was authored before inference. Pipeline fixes were deployed during collection, so it is not a paired comparison of one unchanged model/prompt version.
